_doc: The outer territories, one per sprig type, on a ring around the field. Each holds that type's shrine (carry it home to root it) and a few sprouts to pluck on the spot, plus a puzzle only that type solves. layout: pools (water zones with rewards in them), ring (a closed ring of hazard zones around a cache), cluster (overlapping hazard zones over a cache), walls (a closed ring of stones, no gate: only flyers carry out), open (a load too heavy for anyone but the type). Names are content and may be invented; each must decode.

regions.name: The Mere
regions.line: Still water. Tide sprigs walk the bottom and bring things up.

regions.name: The Wire Fence
regions.line: A live fence around a cache. Only Spark sprigs can cross it.

regions.name: The Fume Bog
regions.line: Poison gas over a buried cache. Thorn sprigs breathe it fine, and poison whatever eats them.

regions.name: The Stone Stacks
regions.line: Treasure walled in with no way through. Moth sprigs fly it out over the top.

regions.name: The Frost Hollow
regions.line: Frozen ground. Frost sprigs stand in it, and enough of them on a beast freeze it solid.

regions.name: The Fallen Oak
regions.line: A brass acorn too heavy for small hands. Oak sprigs lift ten times their share.
